title: Hierarchically stacked nanocrystalline VS2 nanoflowers for enhanced zinc-ion storage performance
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00702J, Paper
Dongxu Wu, Ke Wang, Yong Wei, Linfeng Zhong, Chuanqiang Wu
In this work, polycrystalline P-VS2 was synthesized as a cathode material for aqueous Zn-ion batteries. The unique polycrystalline structure provides more channels for Zn2+ in the interlayer plane, enhancing rate and cycling performance.
